definition: The task of generating a novel image based on a natural language text description.
details: Text-to-image generation, powered largely by diffusion models conditioned on text embeddings, has enabled tools that let users create images from purely descriptive prompts without any artistic or design tools.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. Think of it this way: The task of generating a novel image based on a natural language text description. And here is the clever part: Text-to-image generation, powered largely by diffusion models conditioned on text embeddings, has enabled tools that let users create images from purely descriptive prompts without any artistic or design tools. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Text-to-Image Generation — giving a machine the gift of sight.
